caption: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
scope: Eight predeclared frames per mode; no aggregate score
observations: Normal: the mop moves away across the floor with a mostly continuous handle and a compact head; the head scales down with distance instead of strongly elongating.
Normal: a large wet reflective area remains. These sampled frames do not establish that the puddle disappears behind the mop as requested.
No_c: the mop head deforms, lifts off the floor abruptly in the middle and changes shape again on return; this is less coherent than the normal sample.
interpretation: Some local visual/process stability benefit is visible relative to this checkpoint off-branch control, while semantic completion is still uncertain. Compare full40 and the other declared controls before any overall claim.
